fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master OStim scene controls, convergence-gated free-scene alignment, idempotent shared speed control, Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes, and OCum state snapshots before acceptance.
